title: Why Your Electric Bill Funds AI Data Centers

outro.text: Who signs the check next auction? That is why PJM prices jumped eleven times.

sources: PJM auctions via Rutgers State Policy Lab and Fortune (IEEFA)
Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory via FactCheck.org
Bernstein; Microsoft Sept. quarter via TIKR/Yahoo Finance

scenes.text: PJM capacity prices jumped eleven times. Ohio homes pay sixteen dollars more monthly.
One auction covers thirteen states. Virginia data centers raise New Jersey bills.
Data centers drove sixty-three percent. Nine point three billion from customers.
Critics call it a forward bill. You pay for demand not yet here.

card.title: Power vs. chips
card.source: Bernstein; Microsoft Sept. quarter via TIKR/Yahoo Finance

scenes.text: Microsoft spends thirty-nine billion a quarter. A gigawatt of power costs one point three billion.
Investors paid first. Chip index worst day since April. S&P down two point seven percent.
Construction up forty-eight percent. Utilities seek thirty-one billion in hikes.
